import pandas as pd

# Load source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_58/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_58/training_1.csv"

# Read CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "Mouse ID"
# Join df0 and df1 on "Mouse ID"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Operation 2: PIVOT
# We want to pivot so that each drug becomes a column with values as "Tumor Volume (mm3)"
# The index should be "Timepoint"
# The columns should be the unique values from "Drug"
# The values should be "Tumor Volume (mm3)"

pivot_df = df_joined.pivot_table(
    index="Timepoint",
    columns="Drug",
    values="Tumor Volume (mm3)",
    aggfunc='mean'  # Use mean in case of duplicates
)

# After pivot, columns are drug names, index is Timepoint
# Reset index to make Timepoint a column
pivot_df.reset_index(inplace=True)

# The target schema columns (besides Timepoint) are:
# ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol', 'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

# Some drugs may be missing in the pivot columns, add them with NaN if missing
target_drugs = ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol',
                'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

for drug in target_drugs:
    if drug not in pivot_df.columns:
        pivot_df[drug] = pd.NA

# Reorder columns to match target schema
final_df = pivot_df[['Timepoint'] + target_drugs]

# Convert dtypes to match target schema:
# Timepoint: integer
final_df['Timepoint'] = final_df['Timepoint'].astype(int)

# The drug columns: float
for drug in target_drugs:
    final_df[drug] = pd.to_numeric(final_df[drug], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Save the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_58/target_multisource.csv"
final_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
